brand_identity.positioning_cn: 拥有超过100,000个成功项目的全球领导者，结合先进技术与经证实的质量标准，主要服务于北美、大洋洲和欧洲市场
brand_identity.positioning_en: With over 100,000 successful projects worldwide, Luvindow combines advanced technology with proven quality standards, focusing on markets across North America, Oceania, and Europe. As the flagship brand of Doorwin Windows Inc., Luvindow upholds a tradition of craftsmanship while driving design innovation.

company_background.background_cn: Luvindow以其创新设计和精湛工艺彻底改变了门窗行业。作为一家拥有超过100,000个实际项目案例的全球领导者，工厂面积超过10万平方米，配备意大利进口加工机器，每年可带来50万平方米的生产能力。这意味着我们可以尽可能快地生产和交付我们的产品，以满足客户的时间需求。300多名高技能工人和15名研发工程师意味着我们可以提供全方位的专业服务，并提供更好的建筑解决方案。
company_background.background_en: Luvindow has transformed the door and window industry with its innovative designs and refined craftsmanship. As a global leader with over 100,000 completed projects, our factories cover more than 100,000 square meters and are equipped with Italian-imported machinery, delivering an annual production capacity of 500,000 square meters. This enables us to produce and deliver products swiftly, meeting clients timelines with precision. Our team of more than 300 highly skilled workers and 15 R&D engineers allows us to provide comprehensive professional services and deliver superior building solutions.
